scripts.test:debug: cross-env NODE_ENV=test node --inspect-brk -r tsconfig-paths/register -r ts-node/register node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand
scripts.test:ci: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run test:cov -- --ci --runInBand && npm run test:e2e -- --ci
scripts.migration:generate: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run typeorm -- migration:generate -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:generate:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run typeorm -- migration:generate -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:generate:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run typeorm -- migration:generate -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:run: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run typeorm -- migration:run -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:run:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run typeorm -- migration:run -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:run:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run typeorm -- migration:run -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:revert: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run typeorm -- migration:revert -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:revert:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run typeorm -- migration:revert -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:revert:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run typeorm -- migration:revert -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:show: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run typeorm -- migration:show -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:show:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run typeorm -- migration:show -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:show:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run typeorm -- migration:show -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.db:drop: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run typeorm -- schema:drop -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.db:drop:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run typeorm -- schema:drop -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.db:drop:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run typeorm -- schema:drop -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.db:reset:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test npm run db:drop:test && npm run migration:run:test
scripts.db:reset:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run db:drop && npm run migration:run
scripts.db:reset:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run db:drop:prod && npm run migration:run:prod
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all:cov: npm run test:cov && npm run test:e2e -- --coverage
